About Me

Curious by nature.

I've always been curious about how things work—and how they can be made better.

My journey started with Computer Science, where I discovered that I enjoyed more than just writing code.

Somewhere between technology & people.

I became fascinated by the space between technology and people—how a complex system could become a simple, intuitive experience.

That curiosity naturally led me toward UI/UX design.

Where design meets logic.

I enjoy breaking down complex problems, exploring different ideas, and shaping them into clean, intuitive interfaces and meaningful experiences. I'm drawn to the details that make a product not only look good, but feel simple and natural to use.

At the same time, development gives me the ability to take those ideas beyond the screen and bring them to life through code, combining creativity with logic to build experiences that are both thoughtful and functional.

What drives me.

Simplicity. Curiosity. Aesthetics. Impact. I’m constantly learning, experimenting, and finding better ways to create.

What's next.

My goal is to grow into a product designer and developer who can take an idea from concept → interface → code—creating digital products that are both functional and thoughtfully designed.
